context: Practice interview for a product manager role at Lumen Health (invented). My notes: 4 years as a product manager in a mobile health app. Launched a medication reminder feature that raised weekly active users by 25 percent. Worked with a team of 6 engineers and 2 designers. Reason for leaving: the company is shrinking. Weakness: I say yes too often, now I use a priority list. Do not state a salary number. Questions I want to ask: how the team measures success, what the roadmap focus is, how decisions are made.

lines.text: hi noa thanks for having me

lines.speaker: Noa
lines.text: welcome dan i see on your cv you have seven years as a product manager is that right
it is four years in a mobile health app

lines.speaker: Noa
lines.text: okay tell me about a feature you launched and what changed
i launched a medication reminder it raised weekly active users by twenty five percent

lines.speaker: Noa
lines.text: nice who did you work with
six engineers and two designers

lines.speaker: Noa
lines.text: why are you leaving your company
the company is shrinking and i want to grow in a bigger product team

lines.speaker: Noa
lines.text: our product is regulated and some of the roadmap is slow how do you feel about that
i can plan within the rules and still ship in small steps

lines.speaker: Noa
lines.text: how would you decide which feature to build first
i would compare impact and effort and then check the risk

lines.speaker: Noa
lines.text: and what is an okr and how do you use it
it is a goal with measurable results i use it to align the team

lines.speaker: Noa
lines.text: tell me about a time you disagreed with an engineer
i showed the data listened to his concern and we agreed on a small test

lines.speaker: Noa
lines.text: sam can you bring a water for dan

lines.speaker: Sam
lines.text: sure

lines.speaker: Noa
lines.text: by the way the new building is great do you know the area
i do it is nice

lines.speaker: Noa
lines.text: what are your salary expectations
i would like to hear the range for the role first

lines.speaker: Noa
lines.text: what is your biggest weakness
i used to say yes to everything now i keep a priority list

lines.speaker: Noa
lines.text: we are also launching a new clinic app next year
how does that fit into the roadmap and where would this role sit

lines.speaker: Noa
lines.text: we will see can you send us a case study from your portfolio
yes i will send one

lines.speaker: Noa
lines.text: and we will give you an answer within two weeks
can i ask how the team measures success

lines.speaker: Noa
lines.text: we can talk about it later do you have other questions
yes how is success measured what is the roadmap focus and how are decisions made

lines.speaker: Noa
lines.text: success is activation and retention and the roadmap focuses on the clinic app
great i will send the case study today

lines.speaker: Noa
lines.text: thank you dan
thank you noa
